title: 第20章 沈千尘
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
贵宾席的另一侧，江彻坐在包厢里，面前的桌上摆着一杯没动过的咖啡。

    他的目光从安怜进场开始就没有离开过她。

    今天选拔赛的选手名单他昨晚就看过了。

    四十七个人报名，其中十五个有实战经验，三个上过前线，还有一个SS级的光月觉醒者——沈千尘。

    圣罗兰学院四年前的毕业生，在校期间蝉联三届学院比武大会冠军，毕业后直接进了帝国魔法骑士团。

    安怜要是抽到沈千尘，压根没有胜算。

    林助理坐在江彻身后，小心翼翼地开口：“江总，您别太担心，安怜小姐的治愈能力很强……”

    “我知道。”江彻打断他。

    他知道安怜的治愈能力强，但实战模拟不是过家家，对手不会给她慢慢治愈的机会。

    一个SS级的光月觉醒者，全力一击能在几秒内把人打成重伤，治愈能力再强，也得有命用才行。

    “医生呢？”江彻问。

    林助理赶紧回答：“已经在训练场外面候着了，一共四位，都是帝国最好的治愈系医师，还带了全套的急救设备。”

    江彻嗯了一声，目光重新落在安怜身上。

    他当然希望安怜赢，但他更怕她受伤。

    另一间贵宾包厢里，叶闻白坐在沙发上，面前摊着一份选手名单。

    沈千尘。

    SS级的光月觉醒者，实战经验丰富，封印术造诣极高。

    在整个选手名单里，沈千尘的实力断层式领先，其他人和他完全不在一个水平线上。

    叶闻白合上名单，拿起通讯终端，拨了一个号码。

    “沈千尘的资料，发给我。”

    电话那头很快发来一份详细的档案。

    叶闻白快速浏览了一遍，眉头轻拧。

    这个人几乎没有任何短板。

    魔力强，实战经验丰富，封印术更是一绝。

    安怜如果对上他，赢的概率不到一成。
content_en:
On the other side of the VIP table, Jiang Che was sitting in the box, with an untouched cup of coffee on the table in front of him.

    His eyes had not left her since An Lian entered the scene.

    He had seen the list of contestants for today's trials last night.

    Forty-seven people signed up, fifteen of whom had actual combat experience, three who had been on the front line, and one SS-level Light Moon Awakener - Shen Qianchen.

    A graduate of Saint Laurent College four years ago, he won three consecutive college competition championships during his schooling. After graduation, he directly joined the Imperial Magic Knights.

    If An Lian draws Shen Qianchen, he has no chance of winning.

    Assistant Lin sat behind Jiang Che and spoke cautiously: "Mr. Jiang, don't worry too much, Miss An Lian has a very strong healing ability..."

    "I know." Jiang Che interrupted him.

    He knew that An Lian had strong healing ability, but actual combat simulation was not a game, and the opponent would not give her a chance to heal slowly.

    An SS-level Awakener of Light and Moon can severely injure someone in a matter of seconds with a full blow. No matter how strong the healing ability is, it must be useful for life.

    "Where's the doctor?" Jiang Che asked.

    Assistant Lin quickly replied: "We are already waiting outside the training ground. There are four of them. They are all the best healing doctors in the empire. They also bring a full set of first aid equipment."

    Jiang Che hummed and his eyes fell on An Lian again.

    Of course he hopes An Lian wins, but he is more afraid of her getting hurt.

    In another VIP box, Ye Wenbai was sitting on the sofa with a list of players spread out in front of him.

    Shen Qianchen.

    An SS-level Awakener of Light and Moon, he has rich experience in actual combat and is highly accomplished in sealing techniques.

    Among the entire player list, Shen Qianchen's strength is leading the way, and the others are not at the same level as him.

    Ye Wenbai closed the list, picked up the communication terminal, and dialed a number.

    "Send me Shen Qianchen's information."

    A detailed file was quickly sent over the phone.

    Ye Wenbai glanced through it quickly and frowned slightly.

    This guy has almost no shortcomings.

    He has strong magic power, rich practical experience, and is an expert in sealing techniques.

    If An Lian faced him, the probability of winning would be less than 10%.
